WITH high_value AS (
    SELECT ar.ART_link
    FROM "ArtifactRatings" ar
    WHERE ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score' IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score' AS numeric) >= (
          SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(rating_profile->>'cultural_score' AS numeric))
          FROM "ArtifactRatings" WHERE rating_profile->>'cultural_score' IS NOT NULL
      )
      AND ar.rating_profile->>'exhibit_value' IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(ar.rating_profile->>'exhibit_value' AS numeric) >= (
          SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(rating_profile->>'exhibit_value' AS numeric))
          FROM "ArtifactRatings" WHERE rating_profile->>'exhibit_value' IS NOT NULL
      )
),
vulnerable_organic AS (
    SELECT sd.ART_link, sd.env_handling_sensitivity, sd.ENVsense
    FROM "SensitivityData" sd
    JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON sd.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
    WHERE ac.MatKind IN ('Wood', 'Textile', 'Paper')
      AND sd.ENVsense = 'High'
)
SELECT 
    vo.ART_link,
    ac.art_title,
    ac.MatKind,
    ac.DYNASTY,
    vo.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light' as light_sensitivity,
    vo.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature' as temp_sensitivity,
    vo.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity' as humidity_sensitivity
FROM vulnerable_organic vo
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" ac ON vo.ART_link = ac.ARTregID
LEFT JOIN high_value hv ON vo.ART_link = hv.ART_link
WHERE hv.ART_link IS NOT NULL
   OR vo.ART_link IS NOT NULL;
